title: 获诺奖两年后，他遭到逮捕，被迫用奖金赎身 | 原文
content: Otto Loewi, who won the 1936 Nobel Prize for discovering chemical neurotransmission, suffered severe persecution after Nazi Germany annexed Austria in 1938. The regime stripped him of his university position, seized his property, and confiscated his Nobel Prize money. When arrested and subjected to "protective custody," Loewi was forced to use his remaining funds for his own release. Notably, he prioritized writing experimental data over personal messages during a rare opportunity to contact the outside world while imprisoned.

title: 无预警，OpenAI 突然大规模封号
content: OpenAI unexpectedly deleted numerous ChatGPT accounts without warning, affecting free, Team, and premium users globally. The company attributed this to payment channel issues, specifically citing errors with certain commercial card numbers. This action forms part of a broader crackdown on multiple subscriptions, unauthorized reverse proxies, and API misuse. Recent policy updates have introduced strict device and payment limits, while upcoming changes will mandate official authorization for third-party integrations and merge ChatGPT and Codex usage quotas.

title: 旁观者张朝阳
content: Former Sohu founder Zhang Chaoyang, a pioneer of China’s portal era, admits his company lacks resources for the AI race. Instead of pursuing foundational models, Sohu is pivoting to "Follow Flow," a social product prioritizing human connections over algorithmic recommendations. Zhang also resumed teaching physics, reflecting his academic background. This shift signifies a strategic withdrawal from high-capital technology wars, focusing instead on niche, overlooked user needs and maintaining intellectual engagement despite losing industry dominance.
